goal_ko: 출처를 밝혀 소식을 전하고, 짐작을 말하고, 궁금한 점 말하기

help.blank: ___ to the news, it’s going to snow.

ok: According to the news, it’s going to snow tomorrow.
according to the article robots will cook for us

help.blank: It ___ that more people work from home.

ok: It seems that more people are working from home.
it looks like prices are going up

help.blank: I ___ if people will trust them.

ok: I wonder if it will really happen.
i wonder why people like it

scene.en: Look. According to the news, our city is testing self-driving buses.
It seems that they’re pretty safe so far.
I wonder if people will trust them.
Good point. I wonder if they’ll be cheaper, too.
Let’s try one when they start!

story_notice_ko: 요즘 본 뉴스·기사 이야기예요(날씨, 기술, 스포츠, 동네 소식). 정치 이야기는 하지 않아요. 꾸며도 돼요.

story.en: Have you seen any interesting news lately?

branches.say: Oh, interesting. What do you think about it?

story.screen_hint_ko: 생각을 말해요: It seems that ___. 아니면 I wonder if ___.

ask_me.en: I read that coffee prices are going up again.
ask_me.screen_hint_ko: 반응해요: I wonder if ___. (people will drink less coffee)

recall.hint_ko: ‘According to the news…’로 소식을 전해 보세요

extra_guides: What do you think about it?
privacy_ko: 정치·종교·사건사고 뉴스는 다루지 않아요(나오면 다른 주제를 제안). 토리는 뉴스 내용이 사실인지 확인해 주지 않아요(가상 대화).
